input.summary: Invoice 557 from Lattice Ledger Systems (CAD 9,266.00, dated 2026-10-31) is on hold. Its subtotal of CAD 8,200.00 is well above the fixed monthly fee of CAD 1,320.00 in the active contract C005. It is also far above this supplier's usual invoices, which ranged from CAD 1,386.00 to CAD 1,491.60. The bank account on the invoice (****8068) matches the vendor record, and there are no bank changes on file. So the problem looks like the amount billed, not a payment-details change. No approvals are recorded yet.
